title: FRANCE 24 journalists forced to sign NDA after asking about open letter against media mogul Bolloré
summary: Two FRANCE 24 journalists were forced to sign a non-disclosure agreement after asking an actor about an open letter protesting the growing role of far-right billionaire Vincent Bolloré in French cinema.
